title: Dos & Dont´s / Layout
slide_intent: Keep structure and contrast disciplined so flexible compositions remain clear.
strategic_value: Square surfaces and natural tonal adjustments can give DB layouts consistency without decorative effects.
demonstration: Three positive/negative pairs compare square and rounded modules, balanced and overly dark layouts, and partial darkening versus shadows.
practical_value: Check edge shape, tonal balance and text separation; avoid drop shadows on layout elements.

content_islands.name: Surface shape
content_islands.spec: Compare the square module with a crossed-out rounded treatment.

content_islands.name: Balance
content_islands.spec: Compare a readable image layout with an excessively dark one.

content_islands.name: Contrast method
content_islands.spec: Compare partial darkening with the crossed-out shadow treatment.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy says artificial shadows disturb the layout’s natural aesthetic.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Surfaces are square, contrast and readability remain sufficient, and drop shadows on layout elements are avoided.
reference_purposes.Application: The paired examples demonstrate the checks.
